authorship: assistant test decision implementing user's clear improvement over approximately 3000 requirement
scope: New database candidates after batch8 prototype; does not relabel older experiments
reference_limit: The comparison executable is an audited rebuild from that source, not a recovered official executable.

primary_screen.plan: Existing highest_primary24_v1, six EE default pairs per CPU quota (1 and 2), four retained default pairs per CPU plus two protection pairs per CPU

EE_each_CPU_separately.first_lifecycle_CPU_metric: first_lifecycle_cpu_to_before_shutdown_usec; ends before shutdown, whereas first lifecycle wall includes shutdown request time

primary_screen.protection: Keep existing retained default, wide768 and spill-high-q16 guard measurements and all adverse pairs. No improvement in one case offsets a regression in another. Review tiny first-query absolute times explicitly; no post-result threshold change.
primary_screen.correctness: Root image's real executable, exact ranking, protocol, durability and boundary tests must pass before timing is interpretable.
primary_screen.decision: Passing allows independent confirmation only, not release or official submission. If candidate helps an isolated case but misses clear-gain criteria, retain evidence without recommending a formal attempt.

confirmation.conditions: Fresh runner and root image build, independently generated benchmark seed and same declared CPU/memory limits; freeze exact inventory and checks before execution.
confirmation.criteria: Require the same primary wall/CPU improvement thresholds and protection decisions. Preserve every pair and build identity, including failures.

score_inference: These local criteria justify an expectation, not a numerical score forecast or a guarantee. Official workload, hardware and score normalization remain incompletely known.
